accepted_constraints.identity: The Grosvenor House / 峻岭寄庐 / 峻岭公寓 / 格罗斯凡纳公寓 / 高纳公寓; official gazetteer explicitly says renamed 茂名公寓 in1956, then 锦江饭店中楼. The modeled object is its historic high-rise principal building.
accepted_constraints.inventory_spelling: Fixed inventory says 峻林公寓、茂名公寓; retain that raw record spelling, while the read chapter and visual building use 峻岭. Do not create a second high-rise merely for the 茂名 alias.

address_policy.resolution: Preserve the indexed listed-place range and disclose the chapter’s59號. Exact correspondence between current/historical doors and the listed area remains unresolved.

accepted_constraints.construction: Official chapter says1934 completed and1935 rented. The raw listed record gives1935; keep these distinct completion/letting/listed-year statements.

height_and_storeys.official_storeys: Central18 including one basement; symmetric wing steps16,15,14,13.
height_and_storeys.secondary_conflict: Retrieved Wikipedia says18 above ground and3 underground, differing from the official chapter. This is recorded rather than silently added together.
height_and_storeys.measurement_endpoint: 78m endpoint and grade are unspecified; neither crown top nor equipment/antenna endpoint is established.
height_and_storeys.model_policy: A declared78m author envelope may be based on the documented height, but no derived level spacing, highest cap or roof-equipment height is a surveyed value. Preserve the basement/storey-count disagreement.
height_and_storeys.underground_scope: No underground geometry reconstructed or certified in this exterior model.

accepted_constraints.plan_and_finish: Official: 拱桥样，五折环形，略带弧状; middle and east/west three-part facade with vertical divisions, brown brick and marble at entrance. The main image shows the folded/curved-looking wall and stepped terraces.
accepted_constraints.design_and_builder: Official: 公和洋行和爱尔德打样行设计；友联建造公司承造（一说卢松华的鹤记营造厂施工）. Preserve the alternative contractor attribution.
accepted_constraints.scope: Only the distinct stepped historic high-rise. Exclude independent low west/frontage blocks, links, gardens, auditorium, Cathay Mansions, New Jinjiang Hotel and other complex buildings.
accepted_constraints.listed_place_remainder: Official chapter separately describes6 three-storey apartments west of the high-rise, about10000m² total. It does not settle each current footprint or their exact inclusion in b1-018. Keep this part of the listed place visible as remaining identity/scope review; high-rise completion alone does not close b1-018.

unresolved: Full legal/listed-place boundary for b1-018 and exact identity/extent of the six western low apartments.
Official18 including1 basement versus secondary18 above ground plus3 underground.
78m measurement endpoint, original/current grade, exact terrace depths, setbacks and floor elevations.
Complete opposite rear wall, covered passages, rooftop equipment positions, east/west boundary intersections and exact measured footprint.
Which separate low frontage/compound buildings carry the current name峻岭楼; this cannot be inferred just by two aliases in the raw record.
The figure23985m² is gross floor area, not a footprint test.
decision: The Grosvenor historic high-rise is a distinct buildable object; 茂名公寓 is a documented renamed identity, not automatic proof of a second high-rise. Keep western low buildings and whole-listed-place completeness unresolved.
